visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair tied in a long braid, wearing a lilac sports bra and deep purple leggings with white socks, is kneeling on a lavender yoga mat. She holds a large wooden yoga wheel behind her upper back and head, looking upwards with a focused expression. The studio background is bright with white walls and a large mirror reflecting her form. No text is visible. (2) The scene cuts to her in a tabletop position on the mat, leaning her back against the yoga wheel while extending one leg straight back into the air. She maintains a stable posture with her hands on the floor. The setting remains the same bright indoor studio with neutral flooring. No text is visible. (3) She transitions to a push-up position, supporting her chest and abdomen on the yoga wheel while balancing on her hands and toes. Her face is turned toward the camera with a neutral, concentrated look. The wooden texture of the wheel is clearly visible against her purple attire. No text is visible. (4) The woman is shown lying on her back, arching her spine over the yoga wheel which is positioned under her mid-back. Her legs are raised high in the air, creating a deep vertical stretch. The background mirror captures the full extent of the room's clean, minimalist aesthetic. No text is visible. (5) She returns to a kneeling position, placing one hand on the yoga wheel for balance while extending her opposite arm forward and one leg back in a bird-dog pose. Her gaze is fixed forward, and her body is aligned parallel to the floor. The lighting is soft and even across the space. No text is visible. (6) A lunge-style stretch is performed where her rear foot is hooked over the yoga wheel for support. She raises both arms toward the ceiling, deepening the hip flexor stretch. Gray yoga blocks are now visible on the mat near her front foot for potential support. No text is visible. (7) She sits on the mat with her legs in a wide split, using the yoga blocks under her hands and the wheel to support her torso as she leans forward. The composition emphasizes her flexibility and the practical use of multiple yoga props in a professional studio setting. No text is visible. (8) In the final sequence, she lies on her back and places her feet on the yoga wheel to lift her hips into a bridge pose. She then brings her knees toward her chest while holding the wheel, before finally lying completely flat and relaxed on the mat. The camera remains static throughout these transitions. No text is visible.
